## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-711-01` — '.disk-steward-gate-659' survives the path filter in the MCP backend and the bundle exporter, while sk-/gh*_/AKIA tokens at a name boundary or after '=' are still redacted.
- `AC-TASK-711-02` — explain_growth returns at most its requested limit of changed directories (200 when absent) and says when it truncated.
- `AC-TASK-711-03` — A deterministic test reproduces the convergence race (a change receipt stamped after the sample's start) and passes after the fix; the store's publication-time invariant is unchanged.
